answer: Require each identity to hold title to one distinct land parcel, recorded in the public land registry and rechecked each epoch. One parcel anchors one agent: titles are unique, transfers pay tax and notary fees, and a parcel cannot be cloned like a file. An honest agent registers its single plot once, marked by a cedar on karst ground. A farm needs a thousand separate parcels, each bought, taxed and maintained, while its fakes streak across the ledger like a comet with no ground beneath them.
